Congenital triple rows of eyelashes; eyelid and eyelash abnormalities belong to the ocular axis.
Mitochondrial disorder with myopathy and ophthalmoplegia in 6/6; cerebellar atrophy 5/5; cardiomyopathy (30-79%) omitted at cap; respiratory failure is often neuromuscular.
